_comment: Issue #439 / docs/specs/439-guardrail.md v2. Every entry is a (file, token) hit measured under AC-2's pinned scan rule (git-tracked blobs under core_paths, literal case-sensitive whole-file substring match, one hit per distinct file). category is 'debt' (requires an owning issue -- AC-3) or 'structural' (valid only inside AC-11's closed path allowlist below). Regenerate with core_portability_guardrail.regenerate(): diff-based, preserves hand-set category/reason/issue on surviving entries, lands new raw hits with category=null (fails audit until a human classifies them), drops entries that no longer match anything -- do not hand-edit the entry set without re-deriving per AC-12.

structural_allowlist._comment: AC-11: category=structural is valid only for a file matching one of these. path_prefixes match by startswith; paths must match exactly.
